To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we proposed a novel method based on supervised generative models to characterize AD using neuroimaging and genetic markers, and our method achieved competitive discriminative performance with a novel and more interpretable representation of the disease, compared to state-of-the-art methods.

we propose a novel method based on supervised latent Dirichlet allocation to model AD, and we demonstrate that our method discovers novel and well known patterns that characterize AD, and that our method achieves competitive performance in AD classification.

we proposed a supervised topic modeling approach that jointly exploits image and genetic features for AD characterization and that our model can discover topics revealing well known and novel associations between neuroanatomical and genetic factors.
